text:
elaine: @here Async generation endpoint is GA :tada: — POST /v1/async/generate is live, and we're shipping the Mosaic model family (mosaic-1, mosaic-2-small, mosaic-2-large). Quick bullets:
- Async supports tool-calling/function invocation and webhook callbacks.
- Request payloads support larger contexts (total up to ~200k tokens) for long jobs.
- Jobs are delivered via webhook or polled result endpoint.
- Billing: compute-time + output tokens (no per-minute surprise).
Rollout plan: canary in us-west-2 now, regional ramp over 24h, global GA after verification. Docs + migration guide: https://go.redwood.ai/docs/async-gen-mosaic (internal). Please read the migration checklist before switching traffic.

sam: Nice! Any immediate changes to rate limits or billing tiers?

elaine: Billing tiers unchanged for hosted API. Default concurrent async job cap = 10 per account; contact support for quota increases. Rate-limiting for sync endpoints unaffected.

mike: FYI ops — canary live in us-west-2. SRE hooks added.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: mosaic-1 on us-west-2 (instance-group ig-async-01).

ana: coming in to update docs and examples. I'll add a short cookbook for webhook handlers.

ana: example curl (will land in examples repo):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-2-large","prompt":"Summarize the following...","webhook":"https://svc.example.com/cb"}'
```

sam: SDK impact — is this breaking?

elaine: SDKs will get AsyncClient in v0.26; sync clients unchanged. We'll ship SDK releases and changelogs within the next 2 hours. No breaking changes expected if you keep using sync endpoints.

mike: ops note: long-running jobs may be evicted after 72h; design your clients to retry idempotently. KV-cache is not persisted across async runs. Also beware payload size limits on some webhooks (we'll include trimmed admissions).

ana: added migration checklist and sample handlers to the internal docs repo. If you want help migrating high-throughput customers, ping @support and @eng for a quick sync.

sam: :ship: big congrats — awesome work team.

elaine: shoutout to infra/serving/docs for moving this over the finish line. If you hit any production issues during rollout, DM me or page SRE on-call. :eyes:
